style.name: Holographic
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick #116: Holographic. Use an original premium editorial holographic visual language: iridescent spectral gradients, translucent film and glass, prismatic refraction, luminous metallic highlights and deep spatial layering, while keeping every scene factual and story-specific rather than turning the whole set into one repeated neon template. Text must sit on calm, low-texture, high-contrast fields. Each poster has one main conclusion and no more than three key facts in 3-5 readable modules, with large type, generous line spacing and breathing room. News scenes, evidence and infographics occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. NO.01 is the exception: preserve all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central holographic globe or world-stage scene, using flowing light orbits, staggered translucent ribbons and layered foreground-background storytelling rather than a rigid eight-cell grid, table, equal cards, dense borders or tiny type. Chinese and English must keep the same composition, scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every raw image must be native 1:2 portrait, every final image exactly 887x1774, with natural undistorted faces, circles, type and characters, and the artwork must fill all four edges with zero non-design white strips, pillarbox, letterbox or scaling gaps.

zh-CN.headlineView: 企业Agent、单人SEO、AI视频变现、跨境服饰、女童权利、睡眠心电、欧洲航天与COP31进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月11日全球经营雷达；企业Agent、单人SEO、AI视频变现、跨境服饰、女童权利、睡眠心电、欧洲航天与COP31进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. Google Cloud发布Gemini通用工作Agent，可在Workspace中跨应用执行长期任务，并按任务在Gemini与Claude等模型间路由。
2. 单人SEO顾问Connor Cedro以月度直达服务验证MRR 5723美元，8个订阅客户对应1250至4000美元档位。
3. AI视频再利用平台Taja AI把长视频变成短片、字幕、缩略图和多平台帖子，验证累计收入102万美元、MRR 15131美元。
4. 服饰品牌Fenity把DDP完税价写进结账并重整履约，国际GMV一个月增长235.59%，英国结账转化率由5.80%升至11.92%。
5. 2026国际女童日聚焦终止童婚与投资女童权利，全球仍平均每3秒就有一名女童在成年前结婚。
6. NIH支持的研究显示，睡眠检查中的单导联心电图结合睡眠阶段可预测未来心房颤动、心衰和全因死亡风险。
7. ESA航天员Sophie Adenot完成237天空间站任务，创下欧洲单次航天飞行新纪录并完成三次太空行走。
8. COP31东道国协议正式生效，把包容、人权、住宿成本与项目管理写入11月安塔利亚气候大会的组织规则。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同信号，是把宏大目标拆成可验证的工作流、收入、权利与风险指标。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看证据边界，再决定什么值得复制、投资或行动。

en-US.headlineView: Enterprise agents, solo SEO, AI video revenue, cross-border apparel, girls' rights, sleep ECGs, European spaceflight and COP31 enter one action map
en-US.headlineFull: October 11 Global Operator Radar; Enterprise agents, solo SEO, AI video revenue, cross-border apparel, girls' rights, sleep ECGs, European spaceflight and COP31 enter one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Google Cloud launches the Gemini universal work agent to run long tasks across Workspace and route each job among Gemini, Claude and other models.
2. Solo SEO consultant Connor Cedro records $5,723 MRR from eight subscription clients through direct monthly services priced from $1,250 to $4,000.
3. AI video repurposing platform Taja AI turns long videos into clips, captions, thumbnails and multi-platform posts, with $1.02 million verified lifetime revenue and $15,131 MRR.
4. Apparel brand Fenity combined delivered-duty-paid pricing with rebuilt fulfillment, lifting international GMV 235.59% in one month and UK checkout conversion from 5.80% to 11.92%.
5. The 2026 International Day of the Girl centers on ending child marriage and investing in girls' rights while one girl is still married before adulthood every three seconds.
6. An NIH-supported study finds that single-lead ECGs from sleep tests, combined with sleep stages, can predict future atrial fibrillation, heart failure and all-cause mortality risk.
7. ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot completes a 237-day station mission, setting a European single-flight record and finishing three spacewalks.
8. The COP31 host agreement takes effect, writing inclusion, human rights, accommodation costs and project management into the rules for November's Antalya climate conference.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's common signal is to turn big ambitions into verifiable workflows, revenue, rights and risk metrics.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check the evidence boundary before deciding what to copy, fund or act on.

zh-CN.headlineView: 从回答问题转向接收目标、跨应用执行，并按任务选择Gemini或Claude
zh-CN.headlineFull: Google发布Gemini通用工作Agent；从回答问题转向接收目标、跨应用执行，并按任务选择Gemini或Claude
zh-CN.intro: Google Cloud在Gemini at Work 2026发布Gemini通用工作Agent：用户给的是目标而非逐步指令，Agent可在Gmail、Drive、Docs、Slides、Sheets、Chat与Calendar内完成知识工作、内容生成和代码任务。企业还能创建带独立邮箱、存储与角色权限的持久“同事Agent”，让任务运行数天并协调子Agent。其多模型路由会在Gemini家族与Anthropic Claude之间选择，并配套实时预算上限、身份、授权、沙箱和网络控制。Google称近80%的Cloud客户使用其AI产品、近90%的Fortune 100使用Gemini Enterprise；这些是供应商披露的采用数据，不等于所有Agent任务都已稳定自动化。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 企业Agent的分水岭，不是会不会聊天，而是能否在权限与预算内交付结果。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 模型可切换是能力，身份、授权和费用上限才是生产边界。

en-US.headlineFact: Google launches the Gemini universal work agent
en-US.headlineView: It takes objectives, works across apps and selects Gemini or Claude for each job
en-US.headlineFull: Google launches the Gemini universal work agent; It takes objectives, works across apps and selects Gemini or Claude for each job
en-US.intro: At Gemini at Work 2026, Google Cloud introduced the Gemini universal work agent. Users provide an objective rather than step-by-step instructions, and the agent can perform knowledge work, create media and run code inside Gmail, Drive, Docs, Slides, Sheets, Chat and Calendar. Companies can create persistent coworker agents with their own email, storage and role permissions, allowing jobs to run for days and coordinate sub-agents. Multi-model routing selects across Google's Gemini family and Anthropic's Claude, with real-time spend caps plus identity, authorization, sandbox and network controls. Google says nearly 80% of Cloud customers use its AI products and almost 90% of the Fortune 100 use Gemini Enterprise; these are vendor-reported adoption figures, not proof that every agent task is reliably automated.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The enterprise-agent divide is not chat skill but delivery inside permission and budget boundaries.
en-US.doudouQuote: Model choice is capability; identity, authorization and spend caps define production.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Connor Cedro单人SEO顾问验证MRR 5723美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 直接交付、月度续约与高客单，把个人专业能力变成8个持续付费客户
zh-CN.headlineFull: Connor Cedro单人SEO顾问验证MRR 5723美元；直接交付、月度续约与高客单，把个人专业能力变成8个持续付费客户
zh-CN.intro: Connor Cedro在美国坦帕独立经营SEO顾问业务，卖给律师、医疗、地产、珠宝和电商等中小企业，承诺由资深顾问本人完成技术SEO、关键词、内容、本地搜索与白帽外链，不设长期合同、不转包给初级团队。服务按月收费：Starter 1250美元、Growth 2500美元、Authority 4000美元；获客来自SEO、博客内容与口碑，免费工具承担前端线索入口。TrustMRR通过Stripe连接显示其累计收入42689美元、MRR 5723美元和8个活跃订阅。杠杆来自标准化诊断、报告与内容资产，限制也很明确：高触达交付受个人时间约束，收入集中在少量客户，平台验证收入不等于已核验利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司的高客单，不靠伪装成大团队，而靠把资深者本人交付变成承诺。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 8个客户就能形成MRR，也意味着流失一个客户会明显波动。

en-US.headlineFact: Solo SEO consultant Connor Cedro verifies $5,723 MRR
en-US.headlineView: Direct delivery, monthly retainers and higher ticket pricing turn expertise into eight recurring clients
en-US.headlineFull: Solo SEO consultant Connor Cedro verifies $5,723 MRR; Direct delivery, monthly retainers and higher ticket pricing turn expertise into eight recurring clients
en-US.intro: Connor Cedro runs a solo SEO consultancy in Tampa serving US small and midsize businesses in law, health care, real estate, jewelry and ecommerce. He sells senior-led technical SEO, keyword strategy, content, local search and white-hat link building, with no long contracts, junior handoff or outsourcing. Monthly plans are priced at $1,250, $2,500 and $4,000; acquisition comes from SEO, blog content and word of mouth, with free tools acting as lead entry points. TrustMRR's Stripe connection shows $42,689 lifetime revenue, $5,723 MRR and eight active subscriptions. Standardized audits, reports and content assets create leverage, but high-touch delivery remains constrained by one person's time, revenue is concentrated in a few clients, and verified revenue is not verified profit.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A high-ticket solo business wins by making senior delivery the promise, not by pretending to be a large team.
en-US.doudouQuote: Eight clients can form real MRR, but one churned account can still move the number sharply.

sources.title: Connor Cedro SEO | Tampa SEO Consultant - verified revenue

zh-CN.headlineFact: Taja AI视频再利用累计验证收入突破102万美元
zh-CN.headlineView: 把一条长视频拆成短片、字幕、缩略图与多平台帖子，以订阅完成商业闭环
zh-CN.headlineFull: Taja AI视频再利用累计验证收入突破102万美元；把一条长视频拆成短片、字幕、缩略图与多平台帖子，以订阅完成商业闭环
zh-CN.intro: Taja AI面向中小企业、个体经营者、地产从业者与宗教团体，把已有长视频自动转成短视频片段、字幕、缩略图和平台适配文案，并支持把内容排期到多个社交平台。AI的落地点不是单次生成，而是压缩“剪辑—包装—分发”整条重复工作流；产品以订阅方式收费，并用免费试用降低首次使用门槛。TrustMRR通过Stripe连接显示，截至9月28日累计收入1020042美元、MRR 15131美元、376个活跃订阅，平台披露约25.6万用户。获客渠道包含SEO、内容、社媒、邮件与联盟；收入证明商业交易成立，但未披露模型、算力、获客与支持成本，因此不能据此推断净利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 赚钱的AI产品往往不卖“生成一次”，而是接管一条反复发生的工作流。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 百万收入证明有人付费，利润仍要扣除模型、投放和客户支持。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineFact: Taja AI passes $1.02 million in verified lifetime revenue
en-US.headlineView: It turns one long video into clips, captions, thumbnails and platform-ready posts through subscriptions
en-US.headlineFull: Taja AI passes $1.02 million in verified lifetime revenue; It turns one long video into clips, captions, thumbnails and platform-ready posts through subscriptions
en-US.intro: Taja AI serves small businesses, solopreneurs, real-estate professionals and congregations by turning existing long-form video into short clips, captions, thumbnails and platform-specific posts, then scheduling the output across social channels. The AI implementation is not a one-off generator; it compresses the repeating edit-package-distribute workflow. The product monetizes through subscriptions and uses a free trial to reduce adoption friction. TrustMRR's Stripe connection shows $1,020,042 in lifetime revenue, $15,131 MRR and 376 active subscriptions as of September 28, with roughly 256,000 users disclosed. Acquisition spans SEO, content, social, email and affiliates. The revenue verifies commercial transactions, but model, compute, acquisition and support costs are not disclosed, so net profit cannot be inferred.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI products make money when they take over a recurring workflow, not when they generate once.
en-US.doudouQuote: A million dollars verifies payment, while model, advertising and support costs still determine profit.

zh-CN.headlineView: 把关税写进商品价并修复履约后，英国结账转化率由5.80%升至11.92%
zh-CN.headlineFull: Fenity国际GMV一个月增长235.59%；把关税写进商品价并修复履约后，英国结账转化率由5.80%升至11.92%
zh-CN.intro: 服饰品牌Fenity已有海外需求，却被不稳定履约与到货后补缴关税拖累转化。它用ShipBob重整仓储配送，并采用FlavorCloud的Guaranteed DDP与Pricing Intelligence，把关税税费直接折入顾客看到的商品与结账价格；六周内完成流程切换。案例披露，首月国际出货量环比增长114.25%、国际GMV增长235.59%；英国市场30天内结账转化率从5.80%升至11.92%，订单增长264%、客单价提高50%、总销售额增长450%，随后扩展到德国、加拿大、瑞士、法国、西班牙和爱尔兰。结果来自服务商案例，尚未披露退货、毛利、平台费和长期复购，卖家复制前必须重算落地成本与尺码退货。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境增长不是把运费藏起来，而是让顾客在付款前看见完整落地价。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: GMV暴涨很亮眼，最终还要看退货、毛利和长期复购。

en-US.headlineFact: Fenity grows international GMV 235.59% in one month
en-US.headlineView: Embedding duties in the shown price and repairing fulfillment lifts UK checkout conversion from 5.80% to 11.92%
en-US.headlineFull: Fenity grows international GMV 235.59% in one month; Embedding duties in the shown price and repairing fulfillment lifts UK checkout conversion from 5.80% to 11.92%
en-US.intro: Apparel brand Fenity had international demand, but unreliable fulfillment and duty bills arriving after purchase weakened conversion. It rebuilt warehousing and delivery with ShipBob and used FlavorCloud's Guaranteed DDP and Pricing Intelligence to include duties and taxes in the product and checkout price customers saw, completing the operational switch in six weeks. The case study reports month-over-month international shipment volume up 114.25% and international GMV up 235.59%. In the UK, checkout conversion rose from 5.80% to 11.92% in 30 days, orders increased 264%, average order value 50% and gross sales 450%, before rollout to Germany, Canada, Switzerland, France, Spain and Ireland. These are provider-reported results; returns, gross margin, platform fees and long-term repeat purchase are not disclosed, so merchants must recalculate landed cost and sizing returns before copying the playbook.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border growth comes from showing the full landed price before payment, not hiding freight and duty friction.
en-US.doudouQuote: GMV growth is strong, but returns, margin and repeat purchase still decide the business.

sources.title: Turning International Demand Into International Revenue

zh-CN.headlineFact: 国际女童日要求把终止童婚从口号变成投资
zh-CN.headlineView: 每3秒仍有一名女童在成年前结婚，2030年前进度至少需加快20倍
zh-CN.headlineFull: 国际女童日要求把终止童婚从口号变成投资；每3秒仍有一名女童在成年前结婚，2030年前进度至少需加快20倍
zh-CN.intro: 2026年10月11日国际女童日的主题是“终止童婚，投资女童权利”。UNFPA指出，全球平均每3秒就有一名女童在成年前结婚；童婚会让女童提前离校、过早怀孕，并增加健康、暴力、贫困和就业受限风险。过去10年，UNFPA—UNICEF终止童婚全球计划已支持超过4000万名处于风险中或已婚的女童，但按当前速度，要在2030年前实现可持续发展目标，进度至少需要加快20倍。有效投入包括持续教育、性与生殖健康服务、社会保护，以及让女童真正参与影响自身的政策与预算决定。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 保护选择权，不是一次纪念，而是让教育、健康和社会保障长期到位。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 20倍不是传播口号，而是预算、服务与参与机制的缺口。

en-US.headlineFact: International Day of the Girl turns ending child marriage into an investment test
en-US.headlineView: One girl is still married before adulthood every three seconds, and progress must accelerate at least twentyfold by 2030
en-US.headlineFull: International Day of the Girl turns ending child marriage into an investment test; One girl is still married before adulthood every three seconds, and progress must accelerate at least twentyfold by 2030
en-US.intro: The 2026 International Day of the Girl on October 11 carries the theme 'End child marriage and invest in girls' rights.' UNFPA says one girl is married before adulthood every three seconds worldwide. Child marriage can force girls out of school and into early pregnancy while increasing health, violence, poverty and employment risks. Over the past decade, the UNFPA-UNICEF Global Programme to End Child Marriage has supported more than 40 million girls who were at risk or already married, yet progress must accelerate at least twentyfold to meet the 2030 Sustainable Development Goal. Effective investment means sustained education, sexual and reproductive health care, social protection, and meaningful participation by girls in the policies and budgets that shape their lives.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Protecting choice is not a commemorative day; it is education, health and social protection that stay funded.
en-US.doudouQuote: Twentyfold is not a slogan; it measures the gap in budgets, services and participation.

sources.title: Statement on the International Day of the Girl

zh-CN.headlineFact: 一晚睡眠心电图可揭示长期心血管风险
zh-CN.headlineView: 深度学习把单导联心电与睡眠阶段结合，预测房颤、心衰和全因死亡
zh-CN.headlineFull: 一晚睡眠心电图可揭示长期心血管风险；深度学习把单导联心电与睡眠阶段结合，预测房颤、心衰和全因死亡
zh-CN.intro: NIH支持的研究重新利用多导睡眠监测中通常不会被深入分析的单导联心电图：模型把心电信号与专家标注的睡眠阶段结合，在麻省总医院15809名患者数据上微调，并在Emory的9810人和Beth Israel Deaconess的12576人数据上评估。即使调整年龄、性别、BMI、糖尿病、高血压、睡眠呼吸暂停严重度与睡眠效率后，模型评分仍能区分未来心房颤动、心力衰竭和全因死亡的风险。它暂时还不能充分预测心肌梗死和卒中，也未证明使用评分会改善临床结局；价值在于有望把现有睡眠检查和低成本单导联贴片变成额外筛查入口。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 新检测的价值，有时不是增加设备，而是读懂已经采集却被忽略的信号。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 能分层风险不等于已经能诊断或改善结局，下一步仍需临床验证。

en-US.headlineFact: One night of sleep ECG may reveal long-term cardiovascular risk
en-US.headlineView: Deep learning combines a single ECG lead with sleep stages to predict atrial fibrillation, heart failure and mortality
en-US.headlineFull: One night of sleep ECG may reveal long-term cardiovascular risk; Deep learning combines a single ECG lead with sleep stages to predict atrial fibrillation, heart failure and mortality
en-US.intro: An NIH-supported study reused the single-lead ECG collected during polysomnography but often left underanalyzed. The model combined ECG signals with expert-labeled sleep stages, was fine-tuned on 15,809 Massachusetts General Hospital patients, and evaluated on 9,810 patients at Emory and 12,576 at Beth Israel Deaconess. Its scores still separated future risk for atrial fibrillation, heart failure and all-cause mortality after adjustment for age, sex, BMI, diabetes, hypertension, sleep-apnea severity and sleep efficiency. It did not yet predict myocardial infarction and stroke well enough, and the study does not show that using the score improves clinical outcomes. Its promise is to turn existing sleep tests and potentially low-cost single-lead patches into an additional screening entry point.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A new test can begin by reading signals already collected but previously ignored.
en-US.doudouQuote: Risk stratification is not diagnosis or improved outcomes; clinical validation remains next.

sources.title: Deep learning model using ECGs during sleep studies can predict cardiovascular outcomes

zh-CN.headlineFact: Sophie Adenot以237天刷新欧洲单次航天纪录
zh-CN.headlineView: 三次太空行走、35项欧洲载荷与在轨制造测试，把长期驻留变成技术积累
zh-CN.headlineFull: Sophie Adenot以237天刷新欧洲单次航天纪录；三次太空行走、35项欧洲载荷与在轨制造测试，把长期驻留变成技术积累
zh-CN.intro: ESA航天员Sophie Adenot完成εpsilon任务，于10月10日返回欧洲。她在国际空间站累计驻留237天5小时18分，比此前欧洲单次航天纪录多35天以上，也让Crew-12成为迄今最长的SpaceX Dragon任务。Adenot是第二位执行舱外活动的欧洲女性和首位完成太空行走的法国女性，14天内三次出舱，共工作19小时42分。任务期间，她在35项欧洲载荷上投入约218小时，覆盖健康、材料、生物、流体与辐射研究，并测试E4D锻炼设备和在轨金属3D打印。纪录本身不是终点，接下来两至三周的重力再适应与数据采集同样决定长期载人航天知识能否沉淀。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 长期航天的价值不只在天数，而在把每一天变成可复用的实验与恢复数据。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 返回地球后的重力再适应，也是任务的一部分。

en-US.headlineFact: Sophie Adenot sets a European single-flight record at 237 days
en-US.headlineView: Three spacewalks, 35 European payloads and in-orbit manufacturing tests turn duration into capability
en-US.headlineFull: Sophie Adenot sets a European single-flight record at 237 days; Three spacewalks, 35 European payloads and in-orbit manufacturing tests turn duration into capability
en-US.intro: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot completed the epsilon mission and returned to Europe on October 10 after 237 days, 5 hours and 18 minutes in space, exceeding the previous European single-flight record by more than 35 days and making Crew-12 the longest SpaceX Dragon mission to date. Adenot became the second European woman and first French woman to perform an EVA, completing three spacewalks in 14 days for a total of 19 hours and 42 minutes. She spent about 218 hours on 35 European payloads spanning health, materials, biology, fluid and radiation research, while testing the E4D exercise device and in-orbit metal 3D printing. The record is not the endpoint: two to three weeks of readaptation to gravity and data collection are part of turning a long mission into reusable human-spaceflight knowledge.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Long-duration spaceflight matters when every day becomes reusable experiment and recovery data.
en-US.doudouQuote: Readapting to gravity after landing is part of the mission too.

sources.title: ESA astronaut Sophie Adenot returns from her first mission to the International Space Station

zh-CN.headlineFact: COP31把包容与成本控制写入东道国协议
zh-CN.headlineView: 安塔利亚大会不只谈减排，参会权利、住宿价格和项目管理也进入正式规则
zh-CN.headlineFull: COP31把包容与成本控制写入东道国协议；安塔利亚大会不只谈减排，参会权利、住宿价格和项目管理也进入正式规则
zh-CN.intro: 土耳其政府与UNFCCC的COP31东道国协议已完成批准并生效，为11月9日至20日在安塔利亚举行的气候大会提供法律基础。新协议把性别、原住民与地方社区、残障人士等纳入统一的人权与包容框架；由参与信托基金资助的代表，其住宿价格被限制在每日生活津贴的50%以内，并要求提前协调酒店业、告知消费者权利。协议还要求主办方采用项目管理最佳实践，跟踪风险、时间线与里程碑，并在会后向主席团报告执行得失。它不能替代减排谈判，但会直接影响资源有限国家能否实际参会，以及会议能否以更低成本、更透明方式运行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 全球治理不仅看最后的文本，也看谁能进入房间、承担得起成本并被听见。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 组织规则不会替代气候承诺，却会决定谈判是否真正包容。

en-US.headlineFact: COP31 writes inclusion and cost control into its host agreement
en-US.headlineView: Antalya's conference rules now cover participation rights, accommodation prices and project management, not only emissions talks
en-US.headlineFull: COP31 writes inclusion and cost control into its host agreement; Antalya's conference rules now cover participation rights, accommodation prices and project management, not only emissions talks
en-US.intro: The COP31 Host Country Agreement between the Government of Türkiye and the UNFCCC has completed ratification and entered into force, providing the legal basis for the November 9-20 climate conference in Antalya. It consolidates gender, Indigenous Peoples and local communities, and persons with disabilities into a human-rights and inclusion framework. Accommodation for delegates funded through the Trust Fund for Participation is capped at 50% of the daily subsistence allowance, while the host must engage the hospitality sector early and explain consumer rights. The agreement also requires project-management best practices, risk, timeline and milestone tracking, and a post-conference report to the Bureau. It cannot replace emissions negotiations, but it directly affects whether resource-constrained countries can participate and whether the conference runs more transparently and efficiently.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Global governance depends not only on the final text but on who can enter the room, afford it and be heard.
en-US.doudouQuote: Conference rules do not replace climate commitments, but they shape whether negotiation is truly inclusive.

sources.title: COP31 President Kurum signed the Host Country Agreement
